structured_output.what_is_happening: A FINN token launched on BAGS in May 2025 has sat dormant for about 14 months. In the last ~15 minutes it suddenly came back to life. All of the h1/h6/h24 activity falls inside the m15 window: about $40k volume, 342 buys against 289 sells, 142 unique buyers against 129 sellers, and price up ~139%. The last 5 minutes have already reversed, with price down ~36% and more unique sellers (68) than buyers (52). It is flagged as a community takeover (CTO) with a paid DexScreener boost. Several 'Finn Bags' copycat tokens were launched on pump.fun around 2026-09-25, which suggests something about Finn (the Bags founder) is drawing attention right now. Market cap is ~$17k against ~$11k Meteora liquidity. The ATH price implies an ATH market cap near $470k.

narrative.description: The story is a revival of the original/older FINN token tied to the BAGS launchpad and its founder Finn, likely set off by fresh Finn/Bags news. The same-day copycat 'Finn Bags' launches back that up.
narrative.why_spreading: The copycat launches suggest an outside catalyst around Finn/Bags. The paid boost and CTO also indicate organised promotion on top of that.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the oldest token here with real liquidity and the official-looking FinnOnBagsApp X account and bags.fm page, so it has a claim to being the canonical Bags FINN.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Many 'Finn Bags' pump.fun clones created in the last day or so (one had $15k h1 volume and is now at zero liquidity). An older 'Justice for Finn' and 'The Standing Dog' use the same ticker.

authenticity.evidence: Unique buyers (142) and sellers (129) are fairly broad, and there are 31 smart and 16 renowned wallet tags, although those may be historical. Against that: the CTO, the paid boost, 140 bundler-tagged wallets, a 26% bot/degen rate, and an entrapment-trader share of ~8%.
authenticity.uncertainty: The wallet tags may include trading from the 2025 lifetime. With no X data, the catalyst can't be confirmed.

structural_risks: The spike reversed quickly: -36% in 5 minutes, with net selling
A dormant-coin revival is often a single short pump that CTO holders exit into
One transfer-linked insider network of 4 wallets
GeckoTerminal shows the top 10 holding 55% (may include the pool)

structured_output.counterargument: If a real Finn/Bags catalyst is live, this is the canonical, old, LP-locked FINN. Its ATH was ~27x the current market cap and it is at $17k, so a second wave after the first shakeout could easily double it within 6 hours. Liquidity that is deep relative to market cap also makes it a safer vehicle than the fresh clones.
unknowns: Whether the smart/renowned wallet tags reflect current buying
Whether the CTO group is organised and still buying
How far the -36% m5 dump extends by entry

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical FINN token on BAGS, revived by a CTO and a paid boost, likely alongside real Finn/Bags news (the copycats show that). Structure is sound: authorities renounced, LP burned or locked, no dev holdings. But the pump is already reversing sharply. Revived dormant coins usually fade after the first spike. It keeps some chance of a second leg because it is canonical and has a catalyst.
